entity.name: R. Bernstein
entity.description: Lead maintainer of Mathics3, a free, open-source implementation of the Wolfram Language (Mathematica) kernel written in Python.

projects.name: Mathics3 (mathics-core)
projects.description: Mathics3 is a free, general-purpose computer algebra system implementing the Wolfram Language, an alternative to Mathematica. mathics-core contains the parser, the evaluator and the built-in functions, and is the base of the Mathics3 front ends (command line, Django web interface, Jupyter kernel). It is used in teaching, for running Wolfram Language code without a proprietary licence, and as a reference implementation of the language.

projects.name: Mathics3 Scanner
projects.description: The tokenizer and the tables of named characters and operators of the Wolfram Language, shared by Mathics3 and other tools that read Wolfram Language code.

plans.name: Maintenance and development
plans.description: Maintainer time for reviewing contributions, releases, fixing defects and keeping up with the Wolfram Language.
